component.name: Cloud Photos
component.summary: Browse and edit your iCloud Photos library

description.p: Cloud Photos keeps a complete copy of your iCloud Photos library on your computer and lets you browse it: a timeline, your albums, Favorites, Videos, Live Photos and Screenshots, and a full-window viewer with zoom and video and Live Photo playback.

Edit photos without touching the original: crop, rotate, flip, adjust light and color or pick a ready-made look, then undo, revert or save a copy back to iCloud. You can also favorite, delete and export.
It reuses the sign-in of the iCloud Drive app (icloud-linux) and never asks for or sends your Apple Account password.
Zoom the photo grid to make photos bigger or smaller: the zoom buttons, Ctrl+scroll, pinch, or Ctrl+plus and Ctrl+minus. Photos fill each row at any size, and large sizes show sharper images.
Cloud Photos now also runs on Windows, with its own sign-in (Apple ID, password and two-factor code).

Changes made on other devices (deletes, new photos, favorites, recovered items) show up within a couple of minutes, or as soon as you return to the window, without rescanning the whole library. The grid keeps its place when they arrive.
Recently Deleted: deleted photos and videos, with the days left before iCloud removes them, to recover or delete for good.
Export choices: the original file, JPEG (with a quality setting), PNG or TIFF; full size or smaller; and whether to include the location. The last choices are remembered.

Right-click a photo or video, in the grid of any collection or album or in the viewer, for Open, Favorite, Edit, Export, edit history and Delete. Shift+F10 or the Menu key opens it from the keyboard, and Delete deletes in the viewer.
Deleting and favoriting respond right away: the photo's record is looked up directly instead of searching the whole library, which could take a minute or more with no feedback.
